entries.subject: A false colour from three measured bands, as the HR 8799 planets have
entries.finding: No paper gives flux densities of this planet in three JWST bands like the NIRCam F410M, F430M and F460M that colour HR 8799's planets. A colour from ground-based near-infrared bands would not compare with those (the reason 51 Eridani b's was set aside on 2026-09-23), so the planet is the shared neutral gray.
entries.revisitWhen: Flux densities in three bands comparable with HR 8799's are published.
